ssd.title: Back up your files
ssd.detail: Copy your documents, photos and other personal files to an external drive or a cloud storage service before you start.

parts: SSD that matches the drive slot
ssd.title: Check which drive fits
ssd.detail: Look up the drive slot and interface of this model in its service manual, and buy an SSD that matches them. Have a service provider do this step.

ssd.title: Shut down and remove the bottom cover
ssd.detail: Shut the computer down, unplug the charger, and follow the service manual to disconnect the battery and remove the bottom cover. Have a service provider do this step.

ssd.title: Swap the drive
ssd.detail: Remove the old drive as the service manual describes and install the new SSD in its place. Have a service provider do this step.

ssd.title: Reinstall the system and restore your files
ssd.detail: Reattach the cover, install the operating system from installation media, and copy your files back.

parts: Memory module that matches the slot
ram.title: Check which memory fits
ram.detail: Look up the memory slots, type and maximum of this model in its service manual, and buy a module that matches them. Have a service provider do this step.

ram.title: Shut down and remove the bottom cover
ram.detail: Shut the computer down, unplug the charger, and follow the service manual to disconnect the battery and remove the bottom cover. Have a service provider do this step.

ram.title: Insert the memory module
ram.detail: Insert the module into the free slot at an angle and press it down until the clips lock, as the service manual shows. Have a service provider do this step.

ram.title: Reattach the cover and check the memory
ram.detail: Reattach the bottom cover, start the computer, and check that the system shows the larger amount of memory.

battery.title: Back up your files
battery.detail: Copy your documents, photos and other personal files to an external drive or a cloud storage service before you start.

battery.title: Find a repair offer
battery.detail: Look for a service provider or repair café near you and ask for a quote first. In Austria, a repair bonus may cover part of the cost.

battery.title: Have the battery replaced
battery.detail: Internal lithium-ion batteries are not owner work unless the manual says so. Have a service provider do this step.

battery.title: Recycle the old battery
battery.detail: If you get the old battery back, take it to a battery collection point. Never put it in household waste.

hand_down.title: Back up your files
hand_down.detail: Copy your documents, photos and other personal files to an external drive or a cloud storage service before you start.

hand_down.title: Erase your data and reset the system
hand_down.detail: Sign out of your accounts, then reset the operating system and choose to remove everything, so no personal files remain. On Windows, use Reset this PC with Remove everything.

hand_down.title: Hand it over
hand_down.detail: Give the computer to someone who needs one, or donate it to an organisation that refurbishes computers for reuse.

salvage.title: Back up your files
salvage.detail: Copy your documents, photos and other personal files to an external drive or a cloud storage service before you start.

salvage.title: Erase your data and reset the system
salvage.detail: Sign out of your accounts, then reset the operating system and choose to remove everything, so no personal files remain. On Windows, use Reset this PC with Remove everything.

salvage.title: Shut down and remove the bottom cover
salvage.detail: Shut the computer down, unplug the charger, and follow the service manual to disconnect the battery and remove the bottom cover. Have a service provider do this step.

salvage.title: Remove the reusable parts
salvage.detail: Follow the service manual to remove parts such as the memory modules and the drive, and keep them in an antistatic bag. Have a service provider do this step.

salvage.title: Offer the parts for reuse
salvage.detail: Give the removed parts to a refurbisher, a repair café or someone who can use them.

salvage.title: Bring it to an e-waste collection point
salvage.detail: Take the computer to a municipal collection point or a retailer that takes old devices back. Never put it or its battery in household waste.

recycle.title: Erase your data and reset the system
recycle.detail: Sign out of your accounts, then reset the operating system and choose to remove everything, so no personal files remain. On Windows, use Reset this PC with Remove everything.

recycle.title: Bring it to an e-waste collection point
recycle.detail: Take the computer to a municipal collection point or a retailer that takes old devices back. Never put it or its battery in household waste.

other.detail: Copy your documents, photos and other personal files to an external drive or a cloud storage service before you start.

other.title: Ask a service provider to confirm and do the work
other.detail: Ask a service provider whether this option suits the computer and what it involves. Have a service provider do this step.
